free_tier_limits.correction: Starter tier: no charge, maximum 5 connections, 1,000 API calls per day per organisation, and unlimited data access.

rate_limits.correction: 5 concurrent calls per tenant; 60 calls per minute per tenant; 1,000 calls per day per tenant on Starter or 5,000 on higher tiers; 10,000 calls per minute app-wide.

description.correction: Xero Accounting API provides OAuth 2.0 access to invoices, contacts, payments, bank transactions, and reports across connected organisations. It does not expose unreconciled bank-statement data or support bank-statement reconciliation through the Accounting API.

notes: The API is operational, but the entry incorrectly says rate limits are unpublished and omits known Starter limits. It also overstates reconciliation access: Xero says unreconciled bank-statement data is not exposed and reconciliation must occur inside Xero.
